title: Required tapping before it could be assembled
text: Required tapping before it could be assembled. First of all, I received the item torn open already as seen in the photos. It looked like it had already been returned before. The clear posts holding the upper level on were not tapped deep enough. After tapping it to the needed depth, I was able to assemble it. I am disappointed though, that they would send me an opened item with screws loosely thrown in the box and required manufacturing processes to be completed before Friday nail assembly could be done. If you don't mind taking the extra steps and willing to take your chances, go for it. At the end of the day, the product can still serve its purpose and help organize your cabinet
